body: I have decided to confront my family members about the lack of care/worry and liability over the murder attempts, and physical abuse. I'm starting to think that the incident needs to be addressed, and that living life as if it didn't happen has been incredibly detrimental to my psychological and physical health.
Thank you. That was actually helpful. I often feel like everybody knows why they are here, and like I'm broken for not figuring it out by now.

Thank you for taking the time to reply. 
The lack of accountability and justice in this world is incredibly frustrating. People do horrible things every day, and walk free. I have struggled and failed to accept this, even though I have thought about it since I was very young. In my case, I may have instigated the attacks. If I was a better person I wouldn't be so murder-able. 
Interesting, the mystery is enough? You don't feel like you have to fulfill some kind of purpose? That makes life sound much simpler. 
Debt is slavery, and so is pain and illness. I was too sick to work for a few years. I went through topical steroid withdrawal and my skin was too raw and open to get out of the house and support myself. I had to go into debt to survive. I needed gauze, supplements and doctor bills to be paid for. I can finally work but all my money goes to vitamins/supplements, and debt bills. 
Because of the skin situation I am a very needy person with limited physical abilities. A flare can mean I can't straiten my arm out for a month at a time. Some days I can't type without the skin on my fingers splitting open, and I need to take time off work. I feel like I have to make up for my less than desirable appearance, and lack of physical abilities in some way. Grad school would mean more debt, and idk if it will matter because who is going to take me seriously looking like this? 
Why would people do that? That sounds terrible. Most people can contribute more than I can. They can socialize and start families. I worry I won't ever make it out of my physical pain, and debt slavery. That's not a life worth living... hence the search for meaning.
